snippet.title: 2025: Mosaic Retrospective Trailer
snippet.description:
2️⃣0️⃣2️⃣5️⃣: MOSAIC RETROSPECTIVE is here! 🎉

Solve minesweeper-style puzzles on a HUGE board, gradually revealing pixel art of 2025's biggest stories. 🖼️🧩

The game is FREE, but please consider the Supporter Pack where all proceeds go to @UNICEF.
